axes.model_access: The multi-model picker is an explicit product surface (same-day homepage: the Model item in Agent Settings shows "Smartest (Claude 5.5 Opus)"; the usage panel lists per-vendor consumption for GPT-6.1 Sol / Claude Opus 5.5 / Grok 4.7 / Kimi K3 / DeepSeek V4.1 Flash) — models are billed via credits; the available list per vendor follows the UI.
axes.runtime: Cloud-hosted form (www.gumloop.com direct 200); no official self-hosted distribution found (a community clone repo open-gumloop exists, unofficial); agents run in Gumloop's cloud, metered by credits.
axes.local_files: Workflow and agent data live in Gumloop's cloud; the local-file concept does not apply — artifacts land in third-party systems via connectors (Slack/HubSpot/Gong/Gmail/Salesforce); the SDKs (gumloop-py/js) offer a code-side entry but the runtime stays in the cloud.
axes.background: Always-on and scheduled agents are on record (same-day homepage use-case panel: Renewal Watch / Ticket Triage watch-type agents); queueing and retry details not verified item by item.
axes.tools: The Connectors ecosystem is on record same day (Slack/HubSpot/Gong/Gmail/Salesforce, with a View all entry); the Skills surface is on record (Account Research/Outbound Email/Call Summary/CRM Hygiene); the guMCP_template repo is on record (an official MCP-direction template).
axes.context: Agent instructions (Add instructions) and Skills are the persistent configuration surface; cross-session memory is not verified in official statements, treated as unknown — the knowledge surface mainly comes from connector-pulled external data (CRM/Gong records).
axes.permissions: Enterprise-facing (an Enterprise nav column is on record); ToS entity AgentHub Inc. (doing business as Gumloop) (on record same day); credits billing on record; training-use toggle path not verified item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: multi-model agents for GTM/support (canvas + connectors), unified credits-based usage governance (the Model Providers panel). Not a fit: self-hosting, a filed direct-mainland entry, free unlimited usage (credits metering).
